attributes.description: MIM V3 — major incident overview; one-CI investigation driven by the Incident / CI controls; the CI's related middleware, databases, servers and applications from the CMDB; application and service health (Application and Service controls) with dependencies and blast radius; related dashboards.

config.esql_query:
FROM servicenow-incidents-*, .ds-metrics-system.cpu-default* METADATA _index
| WHERE (priority IN (1, 2, 3) AND opened_at >= NOW() - 31 days) OR @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 day
| EVAL from_inc = _index LIKE "*servicenow*"
| WHERE ci.name IS NOT NULL AND ((from_inc AND priority IN (1, 2, 3) AND opened_at >= NOW() - 31 days)
     OR (NOT from_inc AND (TO_STRING(ci.environment) IS NULL OR TO_STRING(ci.environment) IN ("", "null") OR TO_LOWER(TO_STRING(ci.environment)) LIKE "prod*" OR TO_LOWER(TO_STRING(ci.environment)) LIKE "prd*")))
| STATS cis = VALUES(TO_STRING(ci.name))
| EVAL ci = MV_APPEND("(no CI selected)", cis)
| MV_EXPAND ci
| EVAL ord = CASE(ci == "(no CI selected)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, ci ASC
| LIMIT 10000
| KEEP ci
config.title: CI

config.esql_query:
FROM servicenow-incidents-*
| WHERE priority IN (1, 2, 3) AND state_name NOT IN ("Resolved", "Closed", "Canceled", "Cancelled") AND number IS NOT NULL
| STATS cis = VALUES(TO_STRING(ci.name)) BY number
| EVAL inc = CONCAT(number, " · ", COALESCE(MV_FIRST(cis), "(no CI)"))
| STATS incs = VALUES(inc)
| EVAL incident = CASE(incs IS NULL, "(all incidents)", MV_APPEND("(all incidents)", incs))
| MV_EXPAND incident
| EVAL ord = CASE(incident == "(all incidents)", 0, 1)
| SORT ord ASC, incident DESC
| KEEP incident
config.title: Incident
